meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
During Indian winters, dropping humidity and chilly winds can deplete moisture levels, making a richer, ceramide- or emollient-based cream essential for dry skin.[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-dermatologist-recommended-moisturizers-for-dry-skin-in-india#:~:text=What%20is%20the%20best%20moisturizer%20for%20dry,add%20extra%20support%20during%20the%20driest%20months.) The best options range from intensive barrier-repair creams to reliable drugstore formulations.

The CeraVe Moisturizing Cream is an globally acclaimed barrier cream infused with **three essential ceramides** and **hyaluronic acid** to provide long-lasting hydration.

The Cetaphil Moisturising Cream features a gentle, fragrance-free formula with **niacinamide and panthenol** to soothe and protect sensitive, dry skin.

The Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser provides an **affordable ceramide blend** that prevents moisture loss and supports rough or flaking winter skin.

The Dot & Key Barrier Repair Moisturizer combines **5 essential ceramides and Japanese rice water** to intensely hydrate and comfort dry or irritated skin.

The Minimalist 5% Marula Oil Moisturizer uses **pure marula oil and vitamins F and E** to deeply nourish and soften severely dry or damaged skin during peak winter.

The Himalaya Winter Defense Moisturizing Cream is a budget-friendly option enriched with **natural almond and wheat germ oils** to trap moisture and combat flakiness.
